Story: As a client, I can generate a secure payment token session for ACH or card transactions.
As a client, I can process an ACH charge using a secure payment token session.
As an admin, I can create a new location under an existing organization via API
As a client, I can initiate a payment refund using a valid ACH charge referenceId and token.
As an admin, I can create a new organization via API
As a client, I can link my verified bank account token to my client profile.
As a system, I can authenticate using client credentials and retrieve a valid OAuth token.
As a user, I can register a bank account and receive a token ID for secure storage.
As an admin, I can create a new merchant via API
As an admin, I can create a terminal via API
As an admin, I can create a client profile linked to merchant and location under an organization.
As a user, I can create a new payment session consumer via API
As an admin, I can create a new processor via API
As a Glofox client, I can authenticate and retrieve a valid OAuth token for downstream API access.
As an admin, I can create a new client record via API.
As a Glofox secure service, I can authenticate with secure credentials and obtain a valid OAuth token.
As a secure service client, I can authenticate using secure credentials and obtain an OAuth token.
As a user, I can update existing merchant details via API
As an admin, I can create a company via API for payment processing configuration.
